description: This file defines the 'LegacyGrainId' class within the Orleans.Runtime namespace. It provides mechanisms for creating, parsing, comparing, and representing legacy grain identifiers, including methods for conversion to and from 'GrainId' objects. It maintains internal caches and handles serialization, string formatting, and hash code computations relevant to grain IDs in Orleans.

classes.name: LegacyGrainId
classes.description: Sealed class representing legacy identifiers for grains in Orleans. It provides various factory methods for creation, conversion to other ID types, parsing, comparison, and string representations. It uses internal caching for efficient ID management and supports serialization and hashing.

methods.name: NewId
methods.description: Creates a new LegacyGrainId with a new GUID in the Grain category.

methods.name: NewClientId
methods.description: Creates a new LegacyGrainId with a new GUID in the Client category.

methods.name: GetGrainId
methods.description: Retrieves or creates a LegacyGrainId for a given UniqueKey.

methods.name: GetSystemTargetGrainId
methods.description: Creates a LegacyGrainId for a system target with the specified type data.

methods.name: GetGrainId
methods.description: Creates a LegacyGrainId from specified type code and primary key (long, Guid, or string).

methods.name: GetGrainServiceGrainId
methods.description: Creates a LegacyGrainId for a grain service with specified ID and type data.

methods.name: FromGrainId
methods.description: Converts a GrainId to a LegacyGrainId, throwing if conversion is invalid.

methods.name: FromParsableString
methods.description: Parses a string to create a LegacyGrainId, ensuring round-trip serializability.

methods.name: TryConvertFromGrainId
methods.description: Attempts to convert a GrainId to a LegacyGrainId, returning success status.

methods.name: GetHashCode
methods.description: Returns the hash code based on the underlying key.

methods.name: GetUniformHashCode
methods.description: Calculates a uniformly distributed hash code for the ID.

methods.name: ToString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the ID.

methods.name: ToDetailedString
methods.description: Returns a detailed string representation of the ID.

methods.name: FromParsableString
methods.description: Creates an ID from a string representation.

methods.name: CompareTo
methods.description: Compares this ID to another for ordering.
